title: Find All Duplicates in an Array
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n with values in the range [1, n] and each integer appearing at most twice, return an array of all integers that appear twice.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n with values in the range [1, n] and each integer appearing at most twice, return an array of all integers that appear twice. The algorithm must run in O(n) time and use only constant auxiliary space, excluding the output storage.
constraints: len(nums)=n; every value is in 1..n and appears once or twice.
Return all twice-occurring values in O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
hints: A value v can use array index v-1 as one bit of visitation state.
Negate nums[abs(v)-1] on first sight; if it is already negative, v is duplicated.
Use abs while reading because earlier visits may have changed the sign.
The value bounds provide one unique marker position per possible value without extra storage.
editorial: The value bounds provide one unique marker position per possible value without extra storage.

tests.explanation: Values two and three are each encountered twice.
